name: 94131 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94131 (San Francisco) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94131 (San Francisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
